hypotheses.justification: hsurj follows from the other hypotheses, so it can be deleted. Its only use is in `range_ι_comp_eq_univ`, to show `π.base '' W ∪ π.base '' Wᶜ = univ`. Derive `Set.range π.base = univ` as follows. Since `π` is finite, `π.isClosedMap` makes `range π.base` closed. If it were not all of `X`, its complement would be a nonempty open `V : X.Opens`. Then `π ⁻¹ᵁ V = ⊥`, because no point of `C` maps into `V`. So `Γ(C, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)` is a subsingleton: use `CommRingCat.subsingleton_of_isTerminal (C.sheaf.isTerminalOfEqEmpty ...)`, the same trick the proof already uses, or the instance `Subsingleton Γ(X, ⊥)`. By `hsec V`, `π.app V : Γ(X,V) → Γ(C, π⁻¹ᵁ V)` is injective, so `Γ(X,V)` is a subsingleton. But `Scheme.component_nontrivial` (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Properties.lean) gives `Nontrivial Γ(X,V)` whenever `Nonempty V`. This is a contradiction, so `V` is empty and `π` is surjective. The statement is unchanged and stays true, and the proof only gains this short derivation at the point where `hsurj` is used.
